option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category that can encompass FTD/ALS, making FTD a supertype of the leaf.
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is clinically equivalent to Frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (FTD/ALS).
Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is another term for the spectrum of diseases including FTD/ALS, making it equivalent to the leaf.
Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related) is a specific genetic form of ALS-FTD, which is equivalent to the broader FTD/ALS leaf.
